post.description: Compare expectedActiveId/version with the current open interval under an owner lock. Null/null requires no open interval. Mismatch: 409 ACTIVE_STATE_CHANGED without changes. Same task: return the existing interval with 200. Different task: stop it and create the successor using one server-clock instant, in one transaction. Replay a successful command before rechecking active state.

get.description: Use the owner’s configured zone unless overridden. End is exclusive. Clip intervals to the requested range and local days; open intervals end at one generatedAt instant. Sum durations, including overlaps, using exact nanoseconds. Days are local calendar days, Monday begins a week; DST changes do not assume 24-hour days. No pagination truncates the report totals.

get.description: after is the last processed owner-local sequence. Wait up to waitSeconds if there are no newer events. Retain at least seven days; a cursor older than retained history or ahead of the owner’s head returns 409 RESYNC_REQUIRED. Empty results preserve after. Events are published only after commit; sequence gaps are allowed. Read fresh resources by ID, keeping unsaved local edits until explicitly resolved.

post.description: Validate and import a complete owner-neutral v1, v2 or v3 snapshot atomically with fresh IDs. Preserve task/project/label references and independent sessions. Legacy activity workSessionId values are accepted but ignored, even if the referenced session is absent. Enforce temporal, ownership, identity and one-running-timer/session rules; split multi-day activities at local day boundaries. Never overwrite records or change the account time zone. Limits: 10,000 per type and 20 MiB.

post.summary: Atomically commit a durable import batch
post.description: At most 100 completed source entries and 1,000 resulting daily activities. Source and account zones are distinct; a changed account zone requires new review. A finished batch must reconcile selected entry count and exact imported plus skipped source nanoseconds. Active provenance reuses current records without overwriting edits; ambiguous existing matches require explicit CREATE_DISTINCT or reviewed REUSE choices.

get.description: At most 100 records. DELETE is unchanged and removable; REVIEW needs explicit KEEP or DELETE. REFERENCED, RUNNING and DEPENDENCY require KEEP or resolving the blocker outside Undo. REUSED records are preserved and MISSING records are reconciled. Catalog children commit before parent dependency review.

post.description: Rechecks the exact preview under the owner lock, including versions and dependencies. Deletes only records created by this job through normal domain notifications. UNDONE_PARTIAL identifies deliberately retained created records. Source claims remain for retained records; removing all created parts releases that original claim for deliberate re-import. Cached replies never repeat deletion.

ETag.description: Opaque version required by If-Match on saves.

put.description: Administrator-only redacted desired/effective configuration. Secrets are never returned. Changes require current administrator account proof and a coordinated restart.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer token resolves to one stable server owner and read/write permissions. Never accept owner IDs from clients. TLS is required outside loopback development.

browserSession.name: __Host-timekeeper-session
browserSession.description: Opaque HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax cookie. Configured HTTPS browser requests require the exact canonical Origin, or a matching Referer origin on reads. Unsafe cookie requests also require X-CSRF-Token. A separate host-only HttpOnly browser-binding cookie is issued by same-origin GET /auth/status and refreshed on sign-in. Bearer API/Eclipse requests remain origin-independent; /auth/token-login explicitly exchanges a bearer token for a bound browser session.

Instant.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp, up to nine fractional digits; no local or offset-only timestamps.

ZoneId.description: Valid IANA TZDB zone ID, for example Europe/Oslo or UTC. Unknown IDs are rejected with 422.

Duration.description: Nonnegative ISO 8601 time-based duration with nanosecond precision, for example PT1H30M or PT0S. Durations exceeding a day use total hours.

ProjectInput.description: clientId selects the owner-scoped client. Legacy clients may omit it: creation uses General and edits preserve the existing client.

ActivityInput.description: A recorded interval. Start must not be after the backend clock, whether the interval is open or closed; a future start returns 422 VALIDATION.

workSessionId.description: Retired legacy field. Accepted for compatibility but ignored; work-session context is derived from time overlap.

ActivityUpdate.description: Edit a recorded interval. Start must not be after the backend clock; invalid edits do not change records or versions.

deployedAt.description: Explicitly recorded deployment time; never inferred from process startup.

projectId.description: Optional owner-owned project. Its client determines the session client. Omission preserves the project on edits; null clears it. Older sessions without this field have no project.

WorkSessionInput.description: Web clients supply clientId and title. Legacy interval-only clients may omit them; creation uses General and a title from summary, and edits preserve existing client/title. Null client or blank title is invalid. Optional labelIds are independent of activity labels and are preserved when omitted. An optional projectId selects an owned project and derives its client; an explicitly supplied clientId must match. Omitting projectId preserves it on edits; null removes it.

ImportNanos.description: Exact nonnegative nanoseconds, represented as a decimal string.

mode.description: Web import defaults to WORK_SESSION. Omission retains legacy ACTIVITY behavior; the chosen mode is immutable for a job.

ImportSourceDiagnostics.description: Client-reported CSV diagnostics. Counts reconcile all source rows with selected entries; no unselected source user identity or raw CSV is stored. Server committed counts remain authoritative.

mode.description: Web import defaults to WORK_SESSION. Omission retains legacy ACTIVITY behavior; the chosen mode is immutable for a job.

ImportJob.description: Durable private import authority. GET is authoritative after any uncertain batch reply. Mapping plans are immutable; protected database backups retain jobs, receipts and lineage, while portable domain exports omit them.

mode.description: Web import defaults to WORK_SESSION. Omission retains legacy ACTIVITY behavior; the chosen mode is immutable for a job.

ImportReview.description: Bounded review with a token binding the exact request, current owned records and job version. Changed conditions produce 412. Duplicate decisions are explicit; source changes with a stable ID produce 409. No business data is written by preview.

ImportBatchResult.description: Original durable batch outcome. Repeating the same job/index and content returns this result, including after restart; different content at that index produces 409. Historical results may predate Undo: reconcile with GET job.

canEdit.description: True only for an actual administrator account session, not a token-derived session.

AdministrationSettingsInput.description: Administrator account session and current password required. Save desired settings using If-Match; coordinated restart activates them centrally and revokes retired authentication state. SMTP password is write-only: preserve, replace or clear explicitly.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Exactly one strong ETag returned by GET. Missing: 428; malformed/wildcard/list/weak tag: 400; stale: 412.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Owner-scoped command UUID. Successful responses are durably replayed for at least seven days, including across server restart.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor bound to authenticated owner, filters and revision. Invalid: 400; changed revision: 409 CURSOR_EXPIRED.

Query.name: q
Query.description: Trimmed, case-insensitive substring match on project/label name or task summary.

OwnerBinding.name: X-Timekeeper-Owner
OwnerBinding.description: Optional expected owner for a bound client session: canonical unpadded base64url of its UTF-8 owner ID. Invalid encoding: 400; a different authenticated owner: 401 OWNER_CHANGED before any resource read or mutation. Omission retains stateless token-owner semantics.

Csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
Csrf.description: Required for cookie-authenticated unsafe methods; obtained from /auth/session. Unnecessary for bearer authentication.

AccountKey.name: key
AccountKey.description: Canonical unpadded base64url UTF-8 owner ID; administrator account management only. Never selects a business-data owner.

400.description: Malformed JSON, parameter, header or unknown input field.

example.title: Malformed JSON, parameter, header or unknown input field

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked bearer token, or OWNER_CHANGED when its authenticated owner differs from the expected session owner.

example.title: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked bearer token

WWW-Authenticate.description: Bearer realm="timekeeper"; invalid credentials additionally use error="invalid_token".

403.description: Authenticated token lacks the required read/write permission.

example.title: Authenticated token lacks the required read/write permission

404.description: Resource or referenced resource does not exist in the authenticated owner scope.

example.title: Resource or referenced resource does not exist in the authenticated owner scope

409.description: Domain conflict, changed cursor revision, active-state mismatch or reused idempotency key with different input.

example.title: Domain conflict, changed cursor revision, active-state mismatch or reused idempotency key with different input

412.description: If-Match does not match the current owned resource version.

example.title: If-Match does not match the current owned resource version

413.description: Request exceeds the global 20 MiB HTTP body limit, or portable transfer exceeds 10,000 records per type / 20 MiB export.

example.title: Request or portable export exceeds the documented transfer limit

422.description: Well-formed input violates a field, temporal or relation constraint.

example.title: Well-formed input violates a field, temporal or relation constraint

503.description: Transient server failure. Retry idempotent commands using the same key.
